notes.title: Update v1.03
notes.content: Fixed some minor bugs, increased stamina duration slightly, added additional lights to some areas, reduced collision capsule of spider.

notes.title: Next Update Changes
notes.content:
In the next update there will be a few fixes to minor issues.

I will also include a difficulty selection, where an easier mode provides more stamina and a more predictable enemy patrol path.  The current mode is standard and the enemy movement is entirely random.  This option will be included for those not looking for as much of a challenge, but instead just an experience.

notes.title: Patch v1.02 MiniGame Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed bug with interacting with mini game causing player to be locked out of movement after it has been completed.
